ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: time outside
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist has been cooped up indoors for too long, in a mountain base or through a long winter, and is going stir-crazy. Outdoor work, a walk, or recreation under the open sky will do.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: {PAWN_nameDef} gets enough time under the open sky.

plain.li: I haven't seen the sky in days. I'd settle for standing in the doorway.
Put me on hauling, hunting, anything. Just somewhere with weather.
[winter] I know it's freezing. I don't care. I need to see something that isn't a wall.
[indoors,night] I can hear the wind outside and I'm jealous of it.

warm.li: Could I take the next outdoor job? I'm going pale in here.

blunt.li: Let me outside, or I'll start breaking things.

cheerful.li: Fresh air! Remember fresh air? I'd love a breath of it.

gloomy.li: These walls are all I've seen for days. I'd like to see the sun again before I die.

cold.li: My productivity is falling. The cause is the walls. Assign me outdoors.

plain.li: Wind in my face. I forgot how much I missed it.
The sky's still there. I'd started to wonder.

gloomy.li: Cold and gray out there. Still better than in here.

plain.li: Another day staring at the same wall.

blunt.li: Fine. I'll stay in the dark like a mushroom.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a steady supply of {SUBJECT}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: An addicted colonist with no intention of quitting wants the drug they're hooked on kept in stock. Granting it keeps withdrawal away; refusing it is a choice too.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.fulfilledWhen: At least {TARGET} doses of {SUBJECT} in stock.

plain.li: I know what you're thinking, and I don't care. Keep {SUBJECT} in the stores, or watch me come apart.
I'm not asking for a party. Just enough {SUBJECT} that my hands stop shaking.
[lowmood] Every day without it is a week. Please.

warm.li: I'm sorry. I know it's not good for me. But I can't do my work like this.

blunt.li: Keep {SUBJECT} in stock, or I'll go and find some myself. You won't like where.

cheerful.li: With some {SUBJECT} in me, I'm the best worker you've got! Without it, you get this.

gloomy.li: I've accepted what I am. I'd appreciate it if the colony would too.

cold.li: Withdrawal will cost you more labor than {SUBJECT} costs to make.

plain.li: There it is. I can breathe again.

gloomy.li: Thank you. I hate that I'm thanking you for this.

cold.li: Supply secured. My output will normalize.

plain.li: No {SUBJECT}, then. The shakes will start by tomorrow.

blunt.li: Remember you chose this when I'm screaming at the walls.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: help getting off {SUBJECT}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: An addicted colonist wants to get clean. Stop giving them the drug (the Assign tab's drug policies) and see them through the withdrawal until the addiction passes.

plain.li: I want off {SUBJECT}. Lock it away, and don't listen when I beg for it.
I keep promising myself it's the last time. I need someone else to hold me to it.
[old] I've wasted enough years on {SUBJECT}. I'd like the rest of them back.

warm.li: I want to be someone you can rely on again. Help me get clean.

blunt.li: Take {SUBJECT} off my list. If I yell at you about it, yell back.

cheerful.li: I'm getting clean! The first weeks will be awful, but I'm ready for them.

gloomy.li: It'll be the worst few weeks of my life. Still better than the rest of my life like this.

cold.li: The addiction is a liability. I want it removed. Cut my access.

plain.li: Clean. I didn't think I could. Thank you for not giving in when I did.
The craving's gone, and the shaking with it. I can think straight again.

warm.li: You got me through it. All of you. I won't forget it.

cheerful.li: I'm free of it! I'm celebrating with a nice glass of water.

cold.li: Dependency eliminated. Thank you for your discipline.

plain.li: Still hooked. I'll try again, if I can face it.

gloomy.li: I tried. Or you didn't. Either way, here I am.

plain.li: Still clean. Barely. Keep it away from me.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: not sleeping next to {OTHER_nameDef}
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A colonist shares a bedroom or barracks with someone they can't stand, and wants one of them moved.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: {FOR_nameDef} is sleeping in the same room as {OTHER_nameDef} again.

plain.li: {OTHER_nameDef} snores, mutters, and steals blankets. I'd forgive one. Not all three.
Every night I lie there listening to {OTHER_nameDef} breathe through {OTHER_possessive} mouth. Move one of us.
Sharing a room is bad enough. Sharing it with {OTHER_nameDef} is a punishment.

warm.li: I'm trying with {OTHER_nameDef}, I really am. It'd be easier if we didn't share a room.

blunt.li: Move {OTHER_nameDef} out of my room, or I'll do it myself.

cheerful.li: I'm sure {OTHER_nameDef} is lovely company for someone! Just not at night, in my room.

gloomy.li: I spend all day being miserable. I'd like to sleep without {OTHER_nameDef} watching me do it.

cold.li: We will fight eventually. Separating us is cheaper than the medicine.

plain.li: A whole night without {OTHER_nameDef}. I slept like the dead.

cheerful.li: I slept right through until morning! I'd forgotten I could do that.

plain.li: Another night with {OTHER_nameDef}. Someone's going to get hurt, and I'm not saying who.

ColonyCouncil.WishDef.label: a stocked infirmary
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.description: A doctor looks at the medicine shelf and doesn't like what they see. They want enough medicine for everyone, with some to spare.
ColonyCouncil.WishDef.lostText: The infirmary {FOR_nameDef} asked to have stocked is running bare.

plain.li: I have bandages for one bad day. We get two a week.
Herbs, kits, anything. I can stitch with string, but I'd rather not have to.
[trigger:raid] I used the last of the good medicine on the wounded today. There's almost nothing left for the next lot.
[lowtech] Healroot. A whole field of it. Trust me on this.

warm.li: I want to be able to help everyone who comes to me hurt. Right now I can't.

blunt.li: Get me medicine or start practicing your death rattle.

cheerful.li: A full medicine shelf! I'd sleep so much better knowing it's there.

gloomy.li: Someone's going to bleed out on my table because we were saving silver.

cold.li: Medicine stock per colonist is below safe levels. Treatment quality will suffer, and so will survival rates.

plain.li: Shelves full. Now I can actually do my job.

warm.li: Now I don't have to decide who gets the last kit.

cold.li: Good. Now try not to need it.

plain.li: When someone dies of a scratch, remember this conversation.
